subject: chemistry
text:
Match each item in Column A with its description in Column B.
Column A
(1) a nucleophile
(2) resonance
(3) an electrophile
(4) the inductive effect
Column B
(a) A species short of electrons, which attacks electron-rich sites.
(b) A permanent shift of electrons along a chain of sigma bonds, caused by a polar bond.
(c) A species rich in electrons, which attacks electron-poor sites.
(d) The representation of a molecule by several structures, with electrons spread over them.

points.text: (1) a nucleophile goes with (c).
(2) resonance goes with (d).
(3) an electrophile goes with (a).
(4) the inductive effect goes with (b).
